about: DEV set, round 3 (2026-09-27): look-alike requests that name a tender and a panel list but do not ask for the linked run (advice, hypothetical, past tense, negated), and the requests that still must run it. The 12 items with origin 'review' are the failing inputs of the PR #67 review hand-off; the others were written by the implementer before the fix and then used while building it, so this is NOT held-out. want: link = wants_link is true and the route is bid-parse / run; chat = the route's intent is chat; other = wants_link is false (the request goes to its own post, e.g. pack only).
